remoteAccess.allowModelOutput: Allow model analysis of command output
remoteAccess.modelOutputGrantHint: Only exec commands can share output. Filtered, size-limited output is sent to the configured AI provider and may remain in chat history. Redaction cannot guarantee removal of all secrets. Each command still requires confirmation. For bot analysis, allow this on the remote_exec permission; the bot must request model_output for each command.
remoteAccess.modelOutputChatHint: Commands launched here return private output only. For model analysis, allow it on the remote_exec permission and ask the bot in chat to analyze the route; each sharing command requires confirmation.
remoteAccess.modelOutputWarning: This execution will send filtered, size-limited command output to the configured AI provider for analysis. Output may remain in chat history. Redaction cannot guarantee removal of all secrets. Only approve commands whose output may be shared.
remoteAccess.permanentHint: This permission remains active until you disable it. Commands still require confirmation.
remoteAccess.title: Remote access
remoteAccess.subtitle: Native SSH · Private keys remain in the encrypted vault
remoteAccess.name: Name
remoteAccess.disableHint: New operations will be blocked and active connections closed. Remote processes may continue.
remoteAccess.secretHint: Secrets are write-only. Leave empty to keep the existing secret. Never paste secrets in chat or command text.
remoteAccess.fingerprints: Trusted public host keys (one authorized key per line)
remoteAccess.trustHint: Obtain the complete public host key through an independent trusted channel and verify its fingerprint before saving. First connections are never trusted automatically.
remoteAccess.hops: Route, in connection order (last hop is the target)
remoteAccess.commandHint: The exact command below will run with the Unix account rights. Output stays private and is not sent to the model.
remoteAccess.unknown: Connection lost. The command may have completed. No automatic retry was started.
remoteAccess.approvalHint: Check the target, route and full command before allowing this single execution.
remoteAccess.error: Request failed. Refresh operations before repeating a mutation.
remoteAccess.unsupported: SFTP, background jobs, runbooks and PTY require separate grants.
remoteAccess.outputHint: Output may contain secrets. It is displayed as text only.
remoteAccess.revokeHint: Disabling an identity or permission blocks its use in Iulita. It does not remove authorized_keys or change the server password.
remoteAccess.approvalMissing: This operation cannot be approved without its immutable plan hash.
remoteAccess.generateHint: The private key is saved directly in the encrypted vault and never returned to the browser.
remoteAccess.keyOperation: Manage a public key on a server
remoteAccess.keyHint: Install uses an existing trusted login. Verify uses a separate route with the new key. Remove requires a verified alternative access. Remote changes require separate approval; disabling in Iulita does not remove a remote key.

secretary.processingReady: Last processing completed. Check the draft or saved operation for its outcome.
secretary.processingFailed: Automatic processing did not complete. Refresh status or request a manual draft after checking the policy and limits.
secretary.encryptionRequired: Only connection metadata is available. An administrator must configure encrypted storage before messages, drafts or attachment content can be retained and processed.
secretary.extractedSource: Attachment transcript / extracted text — untrusted source
secretary.rejectDraftConfirm: Discard this exact local draft and cancel its pending approval? This does not undo any earlier Telegram operation.
secretary.draftRejected: Local draft discarded. No new reply was sent.
secretary.mediaBudget: STT reserves 120 seconds per attempt, including failed attempts. UTC daily caps (attempts / seconds): chat 10 / 600, connection 30 / 1800, owner 60 / 3600, bot 240 / 14400. Processing stops at the first exhausted cap. These limits are separate from model tokens.
secretary.autoRulesHint: Only matching message classes inside both account and chat time windows can be sent automatically. Other messages remain drafts. The stricter UTC daily reply cap applies.
secretary.autoTimezone: Time zone (IANA name, for example Europe/Moscow)
secretary.autoDailyCap: Maximum automatic replies per UTC day (1–10)
secretary.autoRulesInvalid: Choose at least one class, a valid time zone, different start/end hours and a cap from 1 to 10.
secretary.peerAutoSettings: Automatic reply rules for this chat
secretary.savePeerAuto: Save automatic reply rules for this chat
secretary.mediaHint: Only the latest incoming attachments, including their observed album, are processed: at most 3 files, 1 MiB each. JPEG/PNG photos are resized to 512 px; PDFs allow 20 pages and 16 KiB of extracted text; plain UTF-8 text allows 16 KiB; voice/audio at most 120 seconds. Older attachments are not reanalyzed. Images use the named model, PDFs are parsed locally and voice/audio uses the named STT service. There is no guaranteed currency cost limit. Unsupported formats, including video source analysis, remain unavailable.
secretary.mediaConsent: I explicitly allow attachment processing by these providers for this account. Each chat also requires consent.
secretary.peerMediaConsent: I explicitly allow processing the latest incoming attachments in this chat by the displayed providers.
secretary.mediaOmitted: {count} older attachments were omitted from media processing. Their contents were not inferred.
secretary.applyTokenConsent: Apply token-only consent to this chat
secretary.autoConsent: I explicitly allow automatic replies to new messages. Each chat also needs its own opt-in.
secretary.autoDisabled: With external actions disabled, automatic mode can only prepare local drafts. It sends nothing to contacts.
secretary.peerAutoConsent: I explicitly allow automatic replies to new messages in this selected chat.
secretary.enablePeerAuto: Enable automatic replies for this chat
secretary.tokenOnlyConsent: I accept a finite daily token cap without a guaranteed currency cost limit when model pricing is unknown.
secretary.tokenOnlyRequired: Generation needs explicit consent to token-only limits because currency pricing is unknown. Manual drafts remain available.
secretary.title: Telegram secretary
secretary.subtitle: Review your account connections and prepare replies in a separate private workspace.
secretary.liveDisabled: External Telegram actions are disabled. Saving or approving a draft does not send it to a contact.
secretary.refreshHint: Refresh reads saved state. It does not generate or send replies.
secretary.connectHint: Connect this bot in Telegram’s Business / Secretary settings. Only selected chats and received updates are available; previous chat history is not imported.
secretary.paused: Local processing is paused. This does not disconnect the bot in Telegram.
secretary.consent: I allow processing and storage of the selected chats under the displayed policy.
secretary.consentHint: This does not select every chat or authorize sending. Enable each chat separately. Model generation uses the named provider; no personal owner memory or other contacts are included.
secretary.historyLimit: Only recent saved messages in this connection are shown, up to 20 here. This is not your full Telegram history.
secretary.peerOff: Processing for this chat is off. Enable it explicitly after reviewing the account policy.
secretary.noMessages: No saved messages available for this chat.
secretary.draftHint: A draft stays in Iulita. Review the full text and recipient before approving any action. It is not a Telegram composer draft.
secretary.generationUnavailable: Model generation is unavailable. You can prepare a manual draft when processing is allowed.
secretary.unknown: The send outcome is unknown. Do not resend automatically. Check the operation status before any further action.
secretary.notSent: Review only — not sent to the contact.
secretary.approvedHint: Approved locally. Sending is a separate action and remains blocked while external actions are disabled.
secretary.savedNotSent: Draft saved. Nothing was sent to the contact.
secretary.capabilityHint: Telegram rights, implemented features and enabled actions are separate. A granted right does not activate a feature.
secretary.eraseHint: Erase saved messages, summaries, indexes, drafts and pending work in this connection. This does not delete Telegram messages or disconnect the bot. Retained backups expire under the configured policy.
secretary.eraseConfirm: I understand that local data for this account will be erased.
secretary.erased: Local data erased. Telegram messages were not deleted.
secretary.exportHint: The export contains private data from the selected scope. Keep the downloaded file private.

errors.reply_window_closed: The Telegram reply window is closed. A new incoming message is needed before replying from this account. Local drafts remain available.
errors.unauthorized: Session expired. Sign in again; no action was retried.
errors.forbidden: This account or action is unavailable to you.
errors.not_found: This item is no longer available. Refresh status.
errors.revision_conflict: The item changed. Refresh and review it again.
errors.expired: This approval or item expired. Refresh and review again.
errors.unavailable: Could not load or confirm the saved state. Try refreshing status.
errors.invalid_request: Check the input and the action limits.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait before refreshing.
errors.unknown_outcome: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh the status; no action was retried.

secretary.textLimit: {count} / 4000 UTF-8 bytes. Longer replies must be shortened before saving.
secretary.approvalPolicyHint: Approval requires Replies after approval for this account and chat, and a valid Telegram reply right.
secretary.rebindHint: Discard quarantined context and old policies, then start from new messages? This does not restore old messages or send anything to contacts.
secretary.erasePeerHint: Erase saved messages, summaries, drafts and pending work only for this chat. Telegram messages and other chats are unchanged. Retained backups expire under the configured policy.
secretary.erasePeerConfirm: I understand that local data for this chat will be erased.

secretaryActions.cancelBeforeChange: Cancel the current pending operation before changing this form? Its saved journal entry remains available.
secretaryActions.editPendingHint: Parameters are locked to this exact preview. Cancel the local approval before editing.
secretaryActions.policyRequired: Preparing actions requires processing consent and the after-approval mode for this scope. Review the account policy and chat policy first.

secretaryActions.noRight: The required Telegram right is not granted.
secretaryActions.allowConfirm: Allow “{method}” in this scope and use replies/actions after approval? This saves local policy only.
secretaryActions.financialHint: This can spend Stars, transfer ownership or destroy a gift. Review the exact asset, recipient and amount. Two separate confirmations are required.
secretaryActions.uploadHint: Choose a local file up to 1 MiB, then upload it to encrypted local storage. It is not sent to Telegram at this step. Stories and account photos currently use static photos.
secretaryActions.uploaded: File stored locally for this operation.
secretaryActions.fileLimit: Choose a nonempty file of at most 1 MiB.
secretaryActions.emptyClears: An empty bio, username or last name removes its current value.
secretaryActions.exactConfirm: I reviewed this account, recipient and all parameters.
secretaryActions.financialConfirm: I confirm this exact irreversible or paid operation a second time.
